title: Create an invite with a first message
summary: Creates one personal invite. The user can give it a name and a first message. The phone keeps the message and sends it into the chat with the invitee when they join (ADR 0136).

name.description: Who the invite is for. Optional, empty by default.

note.description: The first message. Starts as bipe_invite_note_default. The user can edit or clear it.

phase.description: editing: the form. creating: bipe_app_invite_creating. created: the link with share, copy and QR code. failed: bipe_error_invite_quota when no invite is left, else bipe_error_network.

create.effect: POST /v1/me/invites. Keeps the link and, when the trimmed note is not empty, the note on this phone, keyed by the invite id. With a name: PUT /v1/me/invites/{inviteId}. Then phase created.

share.effect: created only: the system share sheet with bipe_invites_share_message and the link.

copy.effect: created only: copies the link and shows bipe_app_copied.

close.effect: Closes the screen. A created invite stays in invites.

notes: The note never goes to the server with the invite (ADR 0136). It is sent once, as a normal end-to-end encrypted text message, into the DM with the person who joined, then deleted from this phone.

Sending: when GET /v1/me/invite-connections lists a new person for this invite, the app finds the DM with that person (Client.getDmRoom) and sends the note with Timeline.send. If the phone is off, the note waits. An invite made on another phone sends its note only from that phone. Bipe logic: BipeInviteNoteSender and BipeInviteJoinNotifier (libraries/bipe invites); BipeInviteStore.saveNote, notes and removeNote (BipeKit); BipeInviteCreator.create(note:) (BipeKit, libraries/bipe invites).
bipe_invite_note_default and bipe_invites_share_message are in the people's voice (pra, spoken imperative), because the user sends them as their own words (linguagem.md section 2).

The invitee side: until a message from the inviter arrives, the invitee's chat shows bipe_inviter_knows_you_joined, and the bipe_inviter_hint with Mandar um oi stays (chat-timeline). Bipe logic: BipeInviterHint (libraries/bipe ui).
The code (CreatedInvite.code) shows only inside the link. The server returns it once.
